name: Intensity Interpolation
definition: An anisotropic volume rendering method that computes the intensity value at an interpolated sample position lying between voxels in two consecutive slices by linearly interpolating the intensity values of those voxels, rather than interpolating density values and recalculating normals.
summary: Intensity Interpolation is an anisotropic volume rendering technique that linearly interpolates pre-computed voxel intensities between slices, avoiding density recalculation and extra storage overhead.
